results.title: The Hammer
results.overview: Simon de Pury is a familiar face in the art world. The former chairman of Sotheby’s has a larger-than-life personality and is known as the «Mick Jagger of auctions.»

results.title: All Greens
results.original_title: 万事快調〈オール・グリーンズ〉
results.overview: Hidemi Boku and Miruku live in a town with no future in sight. To chase their dreams and leave this place behind, there's only one way out—striking it rich! They form a club called "All Greens" and embark on a forbidden extracurricular adventure…

results.title: Strand
results.overview: A man burdened by a mysterious curse meets a woman whose presence feels eerily familiar.

results.title: Midnight Girls
results.overview: Set in Nagoya, Japan, four Filipina entertainers form a sisterhood while facing the emotional cost of their jobs. Together, they must decide what they are truly willing to sacrifice for their dreams in a foreign land.

results.title: Billie
results.overview: Nina and Angie are best friends and struggle through life together. When Angie's teenage daughter Rahel needs €300 for a school trip, they decide to go to the bank where Nina's husband Marc works to ask him for a small loan. But when Marc harshly rejects their request, Angie loses her temper. Things get out of control—and suddenly the friends are stuck in the bank and mistaken for gangsters.

results.title: Maremma
results.overview: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

results.title: RIO DREAMS
results.overview: On his 18th birthday in 90s Rio, a young man and his best friend join a jiu-jitsu gym to protect themselves from local threats. While one believes in dreaming beyond reality, the other rejects hope, convinced his future is already set.

results.title: Stolen Kingdom
results.overview: A look into the underground community of rule-breakers at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida and how their actions led to the disappearance of an Audio-Animatronic named Buzzy.

results.title: Wilderness Tapes: Volume One
results.overview: Nearly a million smartphones and cameras are lost in the wilderness each year. For the first time in history, recovered footage from such devices is presented in a chilling anthology series. Wilderness Tapes: Volume One chronicles a journey into an abandoned gold mine that goes wrong, plunging "Prospector Pete" into the depths of supernatural madness.

results.title: Chère fin,
results.overview: An old postman goes through his last tour of deliveries in the archipelago that he worked in his whole life, gliding on water with his old bike. He finds himself confronted with the reality of his coming retirement.

results.title: Remember the Alamo: Don't Sharia My Texas
results.original_title: Remember the Alamo: Don't Sharia My Texas
results.overview: Texas has always been a symbol of independence, defiance, and the unbreakable American spirit. The Alamo stands as a sacred monument to those who gave their lives rather than surrender their freedom. But today, a new threat is being quietly waged, not with rifles and cannon fire, but through legal systems, community organizations, political infiltration, and cultural pressure. This powerful documentary exposes what its makers call a coordinated, decades-long effort to incrementally introduce Sharia, Islamic law, into American civil society, with Texas as a prime target.

results.title: History of the Marvel Universe Side-Scroll
results.original_title: History of the Marvel Universe Side-Scroll
results.overview: Enjoy a 10-hour musical, scrolling loop of Chris Giarrusso’s epic artwork from “History of the Marvel Universe.”

results.title: Meet Me at the Eclipse
results.overview: In 1995, a young Catholic woman at the end of noviciate finds herself shaken by the flashbacks of a long gone first love.

results.title: I Call Him Dog
results.overview: When reclusive Paul unexpectedly inherits a dog from a deceased relative, his carefully ordered life is thrown into chaos. The energetic dog forces him out of his comfort zone and leads him to Laura, prompting Paul to slowly rediscover love, connection, and life itself.

results.title: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca
results.original_title: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca
results.overview: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca, a new ESPN Films documentary revisiting Diego Armando Maradona’s only return to Estadio Azteca in 2000, 14 years after leading Argentina to its historic World Cup win. The film tells the extraordinary and little-known story of Diego Armando Maradona’s only return to Estadio Azteca after leading Argentina to the 1986 FIFA World Cup title. Maradona returned to the stadium in 2000 while traveling from Cuba to Mexico for Boca Juniors’ Copa Libertadores semifinal against Club América.

results.title: SYNC
results.overview: In the near future, a grieving man turns to groundbreaking technology to reunite with an AI generated version of his deceased fiancé, but as he delves deeper into their virtual encounters, he notices something is off with her programming.

results.title: Chronicle of a False Hitchhike
results.overview: In a desperate attempt to save their relationship, Fernanda and Nico begin a role-playing game during a road trip, which gradually blurs the line between game and reality.

results.title: The Eternity Man
results.overview: In the heart of 20th-century Ukraine, Andriy Voron embarks on an epic journey of survival, love, and healing-one that spans war, imprisonment, and solitude, ultimately transforming him from a young soldier into a wise elder whose spirit transcends time and space.

results.title: Voyager
results.overview: The village of Majamola, Istria, Croatia, the late 1990s. Two owners of an olive farm discover the remains of the Voyager space probe in their garden, which attracts the attention of the astronomers in the Višnjan observatory.

results.title: Großstadtrevier – Knockout
results.overview: In the third 90-minute episode of the popular early-evening series, the overly conscientious precinct chief, Ms. Küppers (Saskia Fischer), of all people, finds herself the focus of the investigation. After a serious traffic accident, Ms. Küppers’ car is found abandoned at the scene, while a pedestrian is fighting for his life. Has the otherwise conscientious chief actually committed a hit-and-run? Lukas Petersen (Patrick Abozen) can’t believe it and, together with Bente Hinrichs (Sinha Melina Gierke) and the team, begins searching for the truth. The trail leads far beyond the events of the night of the accident, right into a web of lies, power, and violence. And Robert Gebhardt (Oliver Mommsen), a longtime friend of Ms. Küppers, also plays a crucial role in the matter.
